description: This Perl script is a utility for flashing firmware onto D-Link DSL-G6x4T devices, specifically targeting Fritz!Box devices. It performs network device discovery via UDP broadcast, interacts with the device via FTP for firmware transfer, and contains functions for device rebooting and environment querying.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with custom methods for interacting with the ADAM2 device, including environment variable retrieval, reboot command, and specific FTP command wrappers.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Overrides FTP USER command with uppercase requirement.

methods.name: _PASV
methods.description: Overrides PASV command to use custom command string.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable from FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variables.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends reboot command to the device.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to trigger device reboot.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a firmware check on the device.
